reason: A UI theming plugin that adds skin controls for gradients, wallpapers, translucency, overlays, and accent colors, with persisted settings and local image handling.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供可持久化的换肤面板，支持渐变预设、图片壁纸、透明度、遮罩和强调色设置。
summaries.en: Adds a persistent skin panel to DeepSeek Harness Web for gradient presets, wallpaper images, translucency, overlays, and accent color customization.

capabilities: customizes the DeepSeek Harness Web interface appearance
persists skin preferences in user settings
accepts and serves uploaded wallpaper images
modifies host integration to expose the skin settings namespace
